strategy.target_user: Home cooks who frequently use bottled salad dressings and are frustrated by sticky, leaky bottles and watery, unappetizing textures.
strategy.core_pain: Bottled salad dressings are unreliable: they leak, create sticky messes, and have a watery, thin consistency that fails to coat salads properly, leading to a disgusting eating experience.
evidence_basis: Memory context confirms cracked caps, leaks, sticky bottles, watery texture, and disgust.

strategy.identity_attack: You think you're saving time with bottled dressing, but you're actually tolerating a messy, inferior product that ruins your salad and your kitchen.
strategy.status_desire: You want to be the kind of cook who effortlessly creates beautiful, perfectly dressed salads without the hassle and mess.
strategy.future_self_gap: Your current self puts up with sticky bottles and watery dressing; your future self enjoys a clean, satisfying drizzle that clings perfectly to every leaf.
strategy.broken_expectation: You expect a bottled dressing to be convenient and tasty, but instead you get leaks, mess, and a texture that feels more like water than a proper dressing.
strategy.visual_hook: A close-up shot of a sticky, leaking bottle cap followed by a perfect, thick drizzle of dressing coating a fresh salad.
emotional_arc: Frustration at the sticky, leaky bottle.
Disgust at the watery, unappetizing texture.
Relief and satisfaction when the dressing adheres perfectly to the salad.
strategy.trust_barrier: Skepticism that a bottled dressing can actually deliver a thick, non-watery texture and a leak-proof seal.
strategy.objection_handling: Address the common belief that all bottled dressings are the same by showing a direct contrast: the competitor's watery run-off vs. our thick, clinging drizzle.
strategy.conversion_mechanism: The visceral relief of seeing the dressing coat the salad perfectly, creating a dopamine-triggering satisfaction that makes the product feel like a solution to a daily annoyance.
strategy.cta_logic: After showing the contrast and the satisfying drizzle, prompt the viewer to 'Stop the mess and get the perfect coat' with a direct link to purchase.
